user.title: Add a local TP-Link/Kasa/Tapo device
user.description: Connect directly to a supported TP-Link, Kasa, or Tapo device by IP address or hostname. TAPO Local uses deterministic local transports and never falls back to the TP-Link cloud.

dl100_session.title: Import DL100 local session
dl100_session.description: DL100 was identified locally. TAPO Local requires the already-authorized local DLKLAP session import at {path}. Copy the saved session cache there, then select Submit to verify it locally. No TP-Link cloud login or handshake0 is performed by this integration.

smart_credentials.title: Local device authentication
smart_credentials.description: This device uses an authenticated local protocol. Enter the TP-Link account credentials currently authorized for the device. TAPO Local uses them only to verify the device locally and stores only python-kasa's protocol-specific credential hash after setup.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device using its forced local protocol.
error.dependency_unavailable: TAPO Local could not prepare its required local-control runtime. No device commands were attempted. Check Settings > System > Repairs and the Home Assistant log for the exact dependency error.
error.dl100_session_missing: The DL100 local-session import file is not present yet. Copy the authorized session cache to the path shown above, then try again.
error.dl100_session_invalid: The DL100 session import file exists but does not contain a valid saved DLKLAP session.
error.dl100_session_rejected: The DL100 rejected the saved local session. A current authorized LAN session is required before the device can be added.
error.unsupported_device: The device responded locally, but its device family or Home Assistant platform is not supported by this TAPO Local build.
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected the supplied credentials.
error.credentials_hash_unavailable: The device authenticated locally, but python-kasa did not provide a reusable credential hash. TAPO Local will not store the plaintext password.

python_kasa_dependency.title: TAPO Local could not prepare its runtime dependencies
python_kasa_dependency.description: TAPO Local requires {requirement}. Home Assistant was unable to leave that runtime in a working state. {detail}
